P-FLEXTOOLS.Purpose: FlexTools: developer tooling for inspecting and diagnosing any RimWorld mod, including mods that do not use FlexVerse. FlexVerse provides the tooling UI foundation. Tools serve both in-game interfaces and programmatic consumers through shared diagnostic capabilities and machine-readable results.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Tool extension contract and registry (M-TOOL, M-TOOL-MANAGER) as direct project-level modules.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Concrete tools hosted as systems (currently S-WIDGET-DEBUGGER; future profiler and behavior debugger follow the same shape).
Scope.SCP-IN-003: Programmatic diagnostic sessions and text export for automation consumers, including the verification plane.
Scope.SCP-IN-004: General-purpose tools target arbitrary RimWorld mods; individual tools may specialize in FlexVerse concepts such as widgets, behaviors and reactive properties.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Framework runtime behavior — FlexTools consumes P-FLEXVERSE as a dependency and never modifies its contracts.
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: Test suites — deferred to the verification plane.

Principles.PRIN-001: One mod = one project: tools are S-* systems with their own decomposition; a simple future tool may be a single M-* directly under P-FLEXTOOLS, like M-TOOL.
Principles.PRIN-002: Tools integrate with the host only through the M-TOOL contract: WidgetInspector : Tool, [Tool(id)] => ToolManager.
Principles.PRIN-003: Runtime observation preserves the target's functional behavior; instrumentation may incur measurement overhead. Targets may belong to any mod or the game.
Principles.PRIN-004: Dependencies on P-FLEXVERSE are expressed by shared symbols in Codemap and FQID in Requirements, never by cross-project parents.
Principles.PRIN-005: Tool interfaces and programmatic consumers share diagnostic capabilities; programmatic collection and export do not require opening an in-game window.
Principles.PRIN-006: Optional diagnostic integrations isolate their dependencies: an unavailable or incompatible external mod disables the dependent capability without preventing other tools from loading.

Technology.TECH-001: C# on .NET Framework 4.8 in RimWorld and Unity, same runtime as P-FLEXVERSE.
Technology.TECH-002: Harmony for observation and instrumentation of target code.
Technology.TECH-003: Inspector UI built with FlexVerse widgets (framework dogfooding).
